name: Beyond The Crime
source:
You are Alia Williams, ranked as one of the best detectives in the country at her young age. During a well-deserved vacation with her family, she must investigate a crime that causes her to have to cancel her vacation.  A very strange case, possibly the most important case in her life. What could have happened?
